gameDescriptionHtml:
After receiving a distress call about an explosion, a detective travels to the remote Archdale Castle in search of answers but finds herself trapped. Can you find out what happened?

Find notes, solve puzzles, and use key items to progress through haunting atmospheric environments in this indie action survival horror. Use a range of firearms, defensive options and melee strikes to take on the horrors that await and learn movement techniques & upgrade equipment that suit your playstyle to prepare for intense boss battles.

Game Features

  • Range of terrifying environments – From the open sea of the misty docks to the tight crypts of a haunted cemetery. Evil Awaits has a range of terrifyingly atmospheric and realistic environments filled with collectables, keys, puzzles, notes, encounters and surprises.
  • Face a diverse horde – A variety of mutations stand between you and what awaits, all with different move sets & weaknesses.
  • Horror in your control – An adapted control scheme allows for swapping sides as well as third & first-person aiming. More ‘classic’ perspectives to be added in the future.
  • Refine your loadout – A range of melee attacks, defensive options, firearms, and more can be found through-out the Archdale grounds. Everything upgradeable from toolkits you will find along the way.
  • Cinematic – Evil Awaits hosts a range of suspenseful cinematic in-game cutscenes, one of many aspects that tell the tale of the Archdale family curse.
  • Survive – A variety of Brutal boss encounters and dangerous hazards lie in wait, can you overcome the challenge?
